English: What are some of the climatic conditions that favor avocado growing?
Kikuyu: Nī rīera rīrīkū rīteithagīrīria gūkūra wega kwa mītī ya mīkorobia?

English: Avocado performs best between 1500-2100m a.s.l. with 1000 mm of well-distributed rainfall
Kikuyu: Mīkorobia īkūraga wega gatagatī-inī ka mita 1500-2100 igūrū kūma iriainī, na 100mm cia mbura njega.

English: It has very low tolerance to salinity.
Kikuyu: Mūceni na thumu nīwagīrīire kuongererwo harī tīīri ūtarī mūnoru

English: If the pH is above 6.5, Gypsum (CaSO4) may be used to lower it.
Kikuyu: Angīkorwo ūrūrū wa tīīri nī makīria ma 6.5, CaSO4 noītūmīke kūmīgūithia.

English: 1200 to 2200 meters above sea level
Kikuyu: Ūraihu wa mita 1200-2200 kūuma iria-inī.

English: Why does Kenya present a favourable climate to avocado production?
Kikuyu: Nīkīī gītūmaga būrūri wa Kenya wonekane wīna rīera rīega rīa kūrīma makorobia?

English: Avocado trees require tropical or subtropical climate because they can’t tolerate either freezing or extreme heat.
Kikuyu: Mītī ya mīkorobia īkūraga wega kūndū kwīna rīera ihehu na kūria kūrī gatagatī-inī nīundū ndīngītiria ūhehu mūkīru kana rīera ihiū mūno.

English: Kenya’s climate is perfectly suited for Hass avocado farming because it lies at the equator.
Kikuyu: Rīera rīa būrūri wa Kenya nīrīega na kūrīma mītī ya makorobia ya hass nīundū wīna rīera rīa gatagatī-inī

English: Hass avocados thrive in Kenya because different areas experience either equatorial or tropical climates.
Kikuyu: Mītī ya mīkorobia ya hass īkaga wega nīūndū icigo ngūrani ikoragwo na rīera rīa gatagatī-inī kana ihehu.

English: What are the ecological requirements for hass production?
Kikuyu: Nī rīera rīrīkū rīagīrīire ūrīmi wa mīkorobia ya hass?

English: Altitude range between 1000-2000m;
Kikuyu: Ūraihu wa kuma iria-inī wa gatagatī ka 1000-2000m.

English: Well distributed rainfall throughout the year of 1000mm-1600mm;
Kikuyu: Mūigana wa mbura wa 1000-1600mm īraura mwaka wī wothe.

English: Irrigation in dry season or in areas with inadequate rainfall;
Kikuyu: Kūhe maaī nī kwa bata mahīnda ma riūa inene kana icigo iria ciīna mbura ītarī njiganu.

English: Optimum temperatures of 20°C-24°C;
Kikuyu: Ūrugarī ūrīa wagīrīire nī wa gatagatī ka 20°-24°c.

English: Loose, sandy or loamy soils, well-draining with pH ranging 5-7;
Kikuyu: tīīri ūtarī mūnyitu ta wa rīūmba, wīna mūthanga, ūtaraiga maaī na wīna ūrūrū wa gatagatī ka 5-7.

English: Minimum of 6 full hours of sunlight a day
Kikuyu: Mathaa matanyihīire 6 ma riūa mūthenya.

English: How is fertilizer top dressed in avocado?
Kikuyu: Mītī ya mīkorobia īheagwo bataraitha atīa?

English: What is the recommended amount of fertilizer that should be used in avocado growing?
Kikuyu: Nī mūigana ūrīkū wa bataraitha wītīkīrīkīte kūhūthīka harī ūrīmi wa mīkorobia?

English: Quantity of manure and fertiliser application is dependent on the soil fertility and the age of trees.
Kikuyu: Mūigana wa thumu na bataraitha ūringanaga na ūnoru wa tīīri na ūkūrū wa mītī.

English: Nitrogen is the most important nutrient in avocado.
Kikuyu: Nitrogen nīcio irio cia bata harī mīkorobia.

English: Basal fertilizers are absorbed by the plants through the roots and include DAP, CAN, NPK, UREA, among others.
Kikuyu: Bataraitha cia mūthingi itūmīkaga nī mīmera kūhītūkīra mīri nanītacio DAP, CAN, NPK, UREA na ingī nyingī.

English: Farmyard manure could also be added, depending on the organic matter of the soil
Kikuyu: Thumu wa mahiū nowongererwo kūringana na ūnoru wa tīīri.

English: What are some of the foliar fertilizers used in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Nī bataraitha irīkū cia mathangū ihūthīkaga harī ūrīmi wa makorobia?

English: They include OPTIMIZER, DIMIPHITE, ZINC GOLD, LAVENDER, GOLDCHANCE SERIES, VITABOR GOLD, among others.
Kikuyu: Nacio nīta:OPTIMIZER, DIMIPHITE, ZINC GOLD, LAVENDER, GOLDCHANCE SERIES, VITABOR GOLD na ingī nyingī.

English: How much water does it take to produce 1kg avocado?
Kikuyu: Nī mūigana ūrīku wa bataraitha ūngīthīkaga gūciarithia kiro īmwe ya makorobia?

English: You need 2,000 litres to produce a kg of avocado fruit
Kikuyu: Ūbataraga lita ngiri igīrī cia maaī gūciarithia kiro īmwe ya makorobia.

English: How is pollination enhanced in avocado orchard?
Kikuyu: Hihi gūciara kwa mītī ya makorobia kūngīgacīrithio atia?

English: The type of avocado cultivars planted in an orchard will contribute to the expected yield.
Kikuyu: Mīthemba ya mītī irīa mīhande nīyo īgūteithia kūgīa na maciaro marīa merīgīrīirūo.

English: There are two types of avocado that flower at different times of the year (type A and type B).
Kikuyu: Nī kūrī mīthemba īrī ya mītī ya avocado īrīa īcanūkana hīndī ngūrani mwaka-inī(Mūthemba A na B).

English: Hence cross pollination leads to higher yields than self -pollination.
Kikuyu: Nī ūndū ūcio, gūciarithania kwa mītī ngūrani nīkūrehaga maciaro maingī kūrī gūciarithania mītī ya mūthemba ūmwe.

English: The presence of bee hives within the orchard is recommended as bees are the main pollinators of avocado.
Kikuyu: Nīwega kūiga mīatū ya njūkī thīinī wa mīgūnda ya makorobia nīūndū njūkī nīcio irutaga wīra ūrīa mūingī wa gūciarithania mītī ya mīthemba ngūrani ya makorobia

English: One should avoid applying chemicals that are harmful to bees.
Kikuyu: Mūndū agīrīirūo gwīthema kūhūthīra dawa iria ingīūraga njūkī.

English: Avocado starts bearing within 3 years after transplanting.
Kikuyu: Mīkorobia yambagia gūciara mwaka-inī wa gatatū thutha wa kūmīruta tuta-inī.

English: Peak harvest occurs between July-August.
Kikuyu: Magetha maingīhaga gītagatī-inī kia mweri wa mūgwanja na wakanana.

English: Why is mulching important in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Mūūceni nī wa bata ūrīkū ūkūria-inī wa mīkorobia.

English: Mulching is undertaken to conserve moisture and to add organic matter to the soil.
Kikuyu: Mūūceni nī wa bata harī kūhonokia maaī na kūnoria tirī.

English: Sawdust should be avoided as it decomposes and ties up nitrogen.
Kikuyu: Mura ndwagīrīire kūhūthīka nīūndū nīwohaga nitrogen warīkia kūbutha.

English: Dry leaves may also be used as mulch.
Kikuyu: Mahuti momū no mahūthīrwo gūthondeka mūūceni.

English: Cultivate around the trees to keep them weed free.
Kikuyu: Rīma ūthiūrūrūkīirie mītī ūkīmunyaga ria rīothe.

English: Note that use of herbicides is not recommended.
Kikuyu: Nīwega kūmenya atī ūhūthīri wa dawa cia kūrīmīra ndwendekithītio.

English: How is pruning done in avocado?
Kikuyu: Mītī ya mīkorobia īcehagwo atīa?

English: Apical bud of young plants should be nipped to slow growth and lead to a compact tree.
Kikuyu: Mūrūri ūrīa wī harīa igūrū wagīrīire kūrengwo nīgetha mūtī ūtige kūraiha na waarame.

English: Lower branches that interfere with cultural activities including irrigation should be pruned.
Kikuyu: Honge cia thī iria iragiria mītī īrīmīkīre wega kana īitīīrīrio maaī na njīra njega ciagīrīire nī gūcehwo.

English: Which crop should be used for intercropping in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Nī mīmera īrīkū īngī īngīrīmwo hamwe na mīkorobia?

English: Avocado orchards may be intercropped with other crops such as beans, peas, kale, or cabbage during the first 3-5 years to get economic returns from the land before the trees start bearing or produce economic returns
Kikuyu: Mūgūnda wa mīkorobia noūhandwo mīmera īngī ta mboco, njūgū, matharū kana kabici mīaka ītatū kana īna ya mbere nīgetha ūingīhie umithio wa mūgūnda kamūiria magetha ma mīkorobia monekete.

English: What is the average yield per avocado tree?
Kikuyu: Mūigana wa magetha ma mīkorobia kaingī nīūrīkū?

English: An avocado tree yields 230-320 kg (7.5-11 t ha–1) of fruit per year.
Kikuyu: Mūtī wa mūkorobia ūciaraga gatagatī ga kiro 230-320kg kana tani 7.5-11 harī eka īmwe.

English: Grafted trees start bearing after 3-4 years after planting but economical crop is obtainable from the sixth year.
Kikuyu: Mūtī wa gūciarithanio wambagia gūciara thutha wa mīaka ītatū nginya īna no magetha maingī monekaga thutha wa mīaka ītandatū.

English: Which standard regulate avocado production in Kenya?
Kikuyu: Nī mūtaratara ūrīkū ūrūgamagīrīra ūrīmi wa makorobia gūkū Kenya?

English: Where can I get propagation materials for avocado be got?
Kikuyu: Hihi ingīruta kū indo cia gūciarithania mīkorobia?

English: Farmers can also plant seeds (local varieties) at farm and later graft using scions from registered mother blocks.
Kikuyu: Arīmi nomahande mbeū cia mītī ya kīmerera macoke mamīciarithanie na zayoni cia mītī īrīa mīhetūkie

English: The farmer can top-work the already existing avocado trees to introduce recommended varieties.
Kikuyu: Mūrīmi no athondeke mītī ya mīkorobia īrīa īrī kuo na njīra ya kūmīciarithania na mīthemba īrīa yagīrīire.

English: What are essential elements in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Hihi maūndū ma bata ūkūria-inī wa mīkorobia nī marīkū?

English: Potassium – important for yield and fruit quality.
Kikuyu: Potassium-nīyabata kūingīhia magetha na gūthakaria matunda.

English: What are the potassium deficiency symptoms in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Hihi nī maūndū marīkū monanagia ūnyihu wa potassium mītī-inī ya mīkorobia?

English: It is characterized by necrosis of leaf margin which starts from the top downwards.
Kikuyu: Wagi ūyū wonanagia kūbutha kwa mathangū mīthia-inī kuuma mwena wa naigūrū nginya wanathī.

English: Fruit quality is highly reduced.
Kikuyu: Ūthaka wa matunda ūkanyiha biū.

English: What are the boron deficiency symptoms in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Hihi ndariri cia ūnyihu wa boron nīirīkū?

English: It is characterized by apical and axillary growing points die off, leaves are distorted (crinkled with holes),
Kikuyu: Ndariri cia ūnyihu wa boron nī hamwe na gūkua gwa thuna, mathangū kūgūnyara na kūgīa na marima.

English: What are the advantages of grafting in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Hihi mawega ma gūceha mītī ya mīkorobia nīmarīkū?

English: Increases resistance to diseases;
Kikuyu: Nī kūongagīrīra hinya wa mītī kūrūa na mīrimū.

English: Increases adaptability to different types of soils;
Kikuyu: Nī kūongagīrīra hinya wa mītī gūkūrīra tīīri-inī ngūrani.

English: Improve yield
Kikuyu: Nī kūongagīrīra maciaro

English: What are some of the field management practices in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Hihi njīra imwe cia gūtungata mītī ya mīkorobia nīirīkū?

English: Mulching;
Kikuyu: Gūthondeka mūūceni.

English: Supporting;
Kikuyu: Gūtira

English: Fertilizer Use;
Kikuyu: Kūhe bataraitha

English: Irrigation;
Kikuyu: Kūhe maaī

English: Pruning;
Kikuyu: Gūceha

English: Thinning;
Kikuyu: Gūthathaūra matunda mītī-inī

English: Weeding;
Kikuyu: Kūrīmīra

English: weed control;
Kikuyu: Kūhūrana na ria

English: pollination
Kikuyu: Gūciarithania

English: What is the importance of pruning in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Hihi bata wa gūceha mītī ya mīkorobia nīūrīkū?

English: Pruning is done at the early stages before flowering to remove premature flowers and fruits and after harvesting.
Kikuyu: Mītī īcehagwo tene ītacanūkīte nīguo kūruta mahūa na matunda maria matarendeka na ningī thutha wa kūgetha.

English: Why is thinning important in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Hihi bata wa gūthathaūra matunda mītī-inī ya mīkorobia nīūrīkū?

English: Why is pollination important in an avocado orchard and how can it be enhanced?
Kikuyu: Pollination nī ya bata ūrīkū ūrīmi-inī wa mīkorobia na īngīgacīrithio atīa?

English: Hass avocado trees are self-pollinating.
Kikuyu: Mīkorobia mūthemba wa Hass nīīciarithanagia.

English: But for a more plentiful harvest, farmers are advised to grow Hass with another variety like Fuerte for cross pollination.
Kikuyu: No nīguo magetha makorūo marī maingī, arīmi nī magīrīirio kūhanda Hass hamwe na mīthemba īngī ta Fuerte nīguo īgacenjania mbeū.

English: What is the nutritional content of avocado?
Kikuyu: Hihi ikorobia rīkoragwo na irio mūthemba ūrīkū?

English: The recommended rate of application is 4 tons per īka for Avocado
Kikuyu: Mūigana ūrīa wagīrīire gwīkīrwo nī tani inya harī īka īmwe ya mītī ya mīkorobia.

English: What is the most critical stage to ensure avocado trees are irrigated?
Kikuyu: Hihi ihinda rīrīa rīa bata mūno rīa kūhe mītī ya mīkorobia maaī nī rīrīkū?

English: The most crucial period when additional irrigation water may be required is around mid January until April (the beginning of the long rains)
Kikuyu: Ihinda rīrīa rīkoragwo rīa bata mūnene gūitīīrīrīa maaī mangī nī kuuma gatagatī-inī ka Janūarī nginya April (kīambīrīria kīa mbura nene)

English: How would a farmer tell that avocados are ready for harvesting?
Kikuyu: Mūrīmī angīmenya atīa makorobia nī makūrū?

English: Since most varieties do not change colour on maturity, a few fruits should be picked and stored at room temperature for 7- 10 days.
Kikuyu: Nīūndū mīthemba mīingī ya makorobia maticenjagia rangi rīrīa makūra, makorobia manini magīrīire gūtūo na kūigwo nyūmba kwa ihinda rīa thikū mūgwanja nginya ikūmi.

English: At what stalk length should avocado be harvested?
Kikuyu: Ikorobia rīagīrīire gūtuo rīrī na kamūtī kaigana atia?

English: Fruit should not be pulled from the stalk but be cut off leaving a 3-cm stalk.
Kikuyu: Ikorobia rīagīrīire gūtuo kuuma mūtī-inī na rīrengwo hamwe na kamūtī kena ūraihu wa 3cm.

English: How should avocado be harvested?
Kikuyu: Makorobia magīrīire kūgethwo atia?

English: It is advisable to train harvesters on harvesting techniques, hygiene and proper handling as well as occupational health and safety.
Kikuyu: Nī wega gūthomithia atui a makorobia maūndū megiī njīra cia kūgetha, ūtheru na njīra njega ya kūmakuua, hamwe na maūndū megiī ūgima mwega wa mwīrī na ūgitīri rīrīa mararuta wīra.

English: Avocado fruits should be clipped from the trees with secateurs, leaving a portion of the stalk attached on the fruit (about 0.5cm long).
Kikuyu: Makorobia magīrīire gūtuo na magathī kuuma mītī-inī, na gūtigia kamūtī kanini kenyitīīrīire itunda-inī(ta 0.5cm).

English: Fruits should be harvested into soft bags or clean buckets and stored in clean crates.
Kikuyu: Makorobia mabatiī kūgetherwo mīhuko-inī mīororo kana ndoo-inī theru na macoke maigwo irīti-inī.

English: Harvesting records should be maintained by the farmer.
Kikuyu: Mūrīmi agīrīire kūiga rekondi cia magetha.

English: How does one determine maturity in avocado?
Kikuyu: Mūndū amenyaga atīa ūkūrū wa makorobia?

English: Dry matter analysis.Dry matter is dependent on variety, region and season.
Kikuyu: Ūthuthuria wa dry matter. Dry matter īringanaga na mūthemba wa mūkorobia, itūra rīrīa ikorobia rīu rīkūrīirio, na kīmera.

English: Dry matter increases as the fruits mature.
Kikuyu: Dry matter yongererekaga o ūria itunda rīrakūra.

English: Fruits can be stored in a warm place (about 20 degrees temperatures) for a week.
Kikuyu: Makorobia no maigwo kūndū kūrī na ūrugarī mūnini (ithimo-inī coa 20oC) kwa ihinda ria kiumia kīmwe.

English: If the fruits ripen without shriveling, that is an indication that the fruits are mature.
Kikuyu: Makorobia mangīruha matekūhoha, monanagia atī nīmakūrū wega.

English: How are avocado fruits harvested?
Kikuyu: Hihi makorobia magethagwo atīa?

English: What are the types of layout designs that should be used in avocado planting?
Kikuyu: Mīkorobia ībatiī kūhandwo na njīra īrīkū?

English: There are different systems of layout, including the rectangular, hexagonal or square system.
Kikuyu: Nī kūrī mīthemba ngūrani ya mīhandīre, o hamwe na gūthondeka kīharo kīna kona inya itaiganaine, kona ithathatū kana ona kona inya ciganaine

English: In Kenya, the rectangular planting pattern is mainly used.
Kikuyu: Kaingī būrūri-inī wa Kenya, mīkorobia īhandagwo kīharo-inī gia kona inya itaiganaine.

English: This permits unhindered movement of machinery between the rows for cultivation, spraying, pruning and harvesting.
Kikuyu: ūndū ūyū nīwītīkagīria macini ihote kūgerera gatagatī ka raini cia mīkorobia ikīrīmaga, ikīhūūraga dawa, gūceha ona kūgetha.

English: It also allows maximum penetration and utilization of sunlight by the lower parts of the trees
Kikuyu: Ningī ūndū ūyū nīūteithagia riūa gūkinyīra honge cianathī na njīra njega.

English: What are the factors to consider when doing site selection for avocado planting?
Kikuyu: Nī maūndū marīkū maroragwo hīndī ya gūcagūra mūgūnda mwega wa kūhanda mīkorobia?

English: This will be followed, if necessary, by levelling off to remove unwanted anthills.
Kikuyu: ūndū ūyū ūcoke ūrūmīrīrio, angīkorwo nī harī bata, kūiganania tīīrī na kweheria ithūa iria itangīendeka.

English: Land preparation is similar to that for other crops, namely one deep ploughing (30 - 40 cm) and two to three harrowings.
Kikuyu: Kūhaarīria mūgūnda kūhana o ta kwa mīmera īrīa ingī, na njīra ya gūcimba ūrikītie (ūriku wa 30 - 40 cm) na gūcokera maita merī nginya matatū.

English: To achieve a good tilth of the cleared land, fruit growers are advised to plant an annual crop a year before starting fruit cultivation.
Kikuyu: Nīguo gītira kia mūgūnda kiagīre, arīmī a matunda magīrīirwo kūhanda mīmera ya kīmera kīmwe mwaka ūmwe mbere ya kūhanda matunda.

English: If frequent strong winds are expected, the early establishment of a windbreak hedge is necessary.
Kikuyu: Angīkorwo nī gūkoragwo na rūhuho rūnene kaingī, nī wega kūhanda rūgiri rwa kūhinga rūhuho.

English: Depending on location, tree species like Cupressus, Casuarina, Grevillea, etc. can be used for this purpose.
Kikuyu: Kūringana na matūra, mītī ta mūtarakwa, mūcindanūgū, mūbariti, na īngī no īhūthīrūo kūhinga rūhuho.

English: Unprotected avocado orchards will be affected by stunted growth, increased evaporation and erosion, defoliation, damaged branches, bruised or even blown off fruits.
Kikuyu: Mīgūnda ya mīkorobia īrīa ītarī na ūgitīīrī no ītūme mītī īhome, maaī maingī kūūra na riūa na tīīrī gūkuo nī kīguū, mītī gūita mathangū, honge kunīkanga, matunda kūgīa ironda kana kūgīa rangi wa gītīri.

English: If there is a choice, level or slightly sloping land is advantageous, otherwise contour cultivation or even terracing may be necessary
Kikuyu: Angīkorwo no ūthuure, mūgūnda mūigananu kana mūinamu hanini nīguo mwega, angīkorūo tiguo, no ūbatare gūthondeka benji.

English: What are the factors to consider when laying out a field for planting avocado?
Kikuyu: Hihi nī maūndū marīkū mūndū agīrīirwo nī gwīciria akībanga mūgūnda wa kūhanda mīkorobia?

English: When laying out the field, one should consider the type of soil and climatic conditions, tree type and size, irrigation, and farm machinery access.
Kikuyu: Rīrīa mūndū arabanga mūgūnda, nī agīrīirwo nī gwīciria ūhoro wa tīīrī wa mūgūnda ūcio na rīera, mūthemba wa mūtī na ūnene waguo, ūhei wa maaī, na ūhoro wa macini irīhūthīkaga.

English: What is the ideal spacing for hass and fuerte?
Kikuyu: Hihi mīkorobia mīthemba ya Hass na Fuerte ībatiī gūtaganio atīa hīndī ya kūhanda.

English: Fuerte and Hass are typically spaced at 9 x 9m (120 plants/ ha).
Kikuyu: Kaingī mītī ya Fuerte na Hass ītaganagio na mīta kenda gwa kenda (Mītī igana rīmwe rīa mīrongo īrī harī o hactare)

English: Prepare holes 60 x 60 x 60 cm (length x width x depth) a month before planting.
Kikuyu: Harīria marima mena ithimo cia 60 x 60 x 60 cm(ūraihu x wariī x ūriku) mweri ūmwe mbere ya kūhanda.

English: How many avocado trees can be planted in an īka in Kenya?
Kikuyu: Hihi īka īmwe ībatiī kūhandwo mītī īigana ya mīkorobia būrūri-inī wa Kenya?

English: The average avocado tree population per īka in Kenya is 150 trees
Kikuyu: īka īmwe būrūri-inī wa Kenya ībatiī kūhandwo mīkorobia igana rīmwe rīa mīrongo ītano.

English: What is the recommended spacing for planting avocados
Kikuyu: Hihi mītī ya mīkorobia ībatiī gūtaganio atīa hīndī ya kūhanda?

English: Spacing of 7-10 m × 7-× 10m ( Hass- 7mx7m, Fuerte 9mx9m, Pinkerton 6mx6m) giving a population of 50-81 plants per īka.
Kikuyu: Ūtagananu wa mīta mūgwanja gwa ikūmi harī mītī ya Hass, Fuerte mita kenda gwa kenda, Pinkerton mita ithathatū gwa ithathatū irīa īkūrehe mūigana wa mītī mīrongo ītano nginya mīrongo īnana na īmwe harī o īka.

English: How should the holes for planting avocado be prepared before planting?
Kikuyu: Hihi marima ma kūhanda mīkorobia mabatiī kūharīrio atīa mbere ya kūhanda?

English: Separate the top and sub-soils.
Kikuyu: Gayūkania tīīri wa igūrū na wa nathī.

English: How is avocado planted?
Kikuyu: Mīkorobia īhandagwo atīa?

English: Make a basin around the seedling for holding water.
Kikuyu: Thondeka gītina-inī ūndū maaī marīrūgamaga hoo.

English: When is the ideal planting time for avocado?
Kikuyu: Nī hīndī īrīkū njega ya kūhanda mīkorobia?

English: Transplanting is more successful when carried out during the long rains either early morning or evening.
Kikuyu: Hindī njega ya gūthamia mīūngūrwa nī rīrīa kūrī na mbura nene ya kīmera mathaa na rūcinī tene kana hwainī.

English: In hot areas, shade the seedlings after transplanting.
Kikuyu: Nīwega gūthondekera mīūngūrwa ciīruru thutha wa kūmīthamia angīkorwo nīkūrī rīūa ihiū.

English: What are the steps involved in planting of hass avocado?
Kikuyu: Nī makinya marīkū magīrīire kūrūmīrīrwo hīndī ya kūhanda mīkorobia mīthemba ya Hass?

English: Prepare the land by removing stumps and plough the land up to 30cm
Kikuyu: Kūhaarīria mūgūnda na njīra ya kweheria ithukī na gūcimba mūgūnda ūcio na ūriku wa centimita mīrongo ītatū.

English: Ensure there are windbreakers such as hedges if the area has strong winds.
Kikuyu: Nīwega kūhanda ngiri cia kūhinga rūhuho angīkorwo itūra rīrī nīrīgūmagīrwo nī huho nene.

English: Dig holes 2ft by 2ft by 2ft.
Kikuyu: Enja marima ma futi igīrī kwa igīrī kwa igīrī.

English: Separate the top soil and the subsoil.
Kikuyu: Kūgayūkania tīri ūrīa ūrī igūrū na ūrīa ūrī na thīī.

English: Put the topsoil on the left side and the sub-soil on the right.
Kikuyu: Iga tīīri wa igūrū mwena wa ūmotho na wa nathīī mwena wa ūrīo.

English: Mix topsoil with two debes (buckets) of well-decomposed manure and a handful of NPK (20:10:10) fertilizer;
Kikuyu: Tukanaia tīīri wa igūrū na ndebe igīrī cia thumu mūhīu wega na wongerere rūhī rwa bataraitha ya NPK(20:10:10).

English: Fill back the soil-manure-fertilizer mix;
Kikuyu: Cokia mūtukanio ūyū wa tīīri-thumu-bataraitha irima-inī.

English: Remove the polythene, plant the Hass avocado seedling carefully and firm the soil around the hole;
Kikuyu: Ruta karatathi ka mūnyore, handa mūkorobia wa Hass ūmenyereire na ūkindīre tīīri irima-inī rīū.

English: It is now time to transplant your Hass avocado seedling.
Kikuyu: Rīu nī ihinda rīa gūthamia mīūngūrwa ya Hass.

English: Farmers are advised to transplant during the start of the rainy season.
Kikuyu: Arīmi magīrīirwo nī gūthamia mīūngūrwa īyo hīndī īrīa mbura īrambīrīria.

English: In Kenya is at the end of April.
Kikuyu: Ihinda rīrī būrūri-inī wa Kenya nī mūthia-inī wa mweri wa īna.

English: This will enable your Hass avocados to establish themselves well on the farm.
Kikuyu: ūndū ūyū nī ūtūmaga mīūngūrwa ya Hass īhande wega

English: What is the ideal spacing for hass and how many trees can i plant per īka?
Kikuyu: Hihi mīkorobia ya Hass ībatiī gūtaganio atīa na nī mītī īgana ībatiī kūhandwo īka-inī īmwe?

English: The standard spacing for Hass avocado in Kenya is 5m by 5m.
Kikuyu: Kaingī mīkorobia ya Hass būrūri-inī wa kenya ītaganagio na mita ithano gwa ithano.

English: With this spacing, 150 Hass avocado trees can be planted in an īka.
Kikuyu: Gūtagania gūkū nīgūtūmaga mītī igana rīmwe ria mīrongo ītano īkahandīka īka-inī īmwe.

English: What are the factors to consider in nursery site selection?
Kikuyu: Nī maūndū marīkū magīrīirūo gwīcirio hīndī ya gūcagūra handū ha gūthondeka natharī ya mīkorobia.

English: Nearness to quality water source;
Kikuyu: Handū hakūhīrīirīe kīhumo kia maaī.

English: Good drainage; Security (Animals, thieves etc.)
Kikuyu: tīīri ūraikūrūkia maaī wega; ūgitīri (Nyamū, aici, na maūndū mangī)

English: Accessibility to the road;
Kikuyu: Ūkinyanīria wa barabara;

English: Availability of wind breaks (Casuarina, Grevillea etc.)
Kikuyu: Handū harī na ngiri cia kūhinga rūhuho(mītarakwa, mībariti etc).

English: How should a nursery be established?
Kikuyu: Natharī ya mīkorobia ībatiī gūthondekwo atīa?

English: Prepare a seedbed of width 1 m and a desirable length by removing farm soil from the seedbed to a depth of 30 cm and refill the 30 cm depression with sand
Kikuyu: Harīria natharī īrī na wariī wa mita īmwe na ūraihu ūrīa wagīrīire na njīra ya kweheria tīīrī natharī-inī īyo nginya ūriku wa 30cm na ūcoke wīihūrie mūtaro ūcio na mūthanga.

English: What are the characteristics of mother trees to collect seed from?
Kikuyu: Hihi mīkorobia īrīa īhūthagīrūo kūruta mbeū īkoragwo na ngumo īrīkū?

English: Collect seed only from healthy and vigorous mother trees and from fruits which are mature and healthy rather than from off the ground
Kikuyu: Ūngania mbeū kuuma kūrī mītī ītarī mīrwaru na īrīa īrakūra na hinya na ni nīngī kuuma kūrī matunda marīa makūrū na mega matarī maragwa thīī.

English: What are features of potting media?
Kikuyu: tīīri ūrīa wīkīragwo mīnyore-inī ya mīūngūrwa ūbatiī gūkorwo ūhana atīa?

English: Potting media: medium texture, sterilized if possible and with good drainage properties
Kikuyu: tīīrī ūyū ūbatiī gūkorwo ūrī mūhinyu hanini, ūtarī njamuthi na ūraikūrūkia maaī wega.

English: What are some of nursery management practices in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Njīra imwe cia kūmenyerera natharī ya mīkorobia nī irīkū?

English: Nurseries should be sited away from Pineapple fields as this is a source of Phytopthora cinnamoni infection.
Kikuyu: Natharī cia mīkorobia ibatiī gūthondekwo haraya na mūgūnda wa mananathi nīūndū nīmo kīhumo kia mūrimū mūrū wa Phytopthora Cinnamoni.

English: Avoid formation of hard pans on the potted plant by regularly pricking the soil with a sharp stick
Kikuyu: Girīrīria kūmagara gwa tīīrī ūrīa wīkīrītwo mīnyore-inī ya mīūngūrwa na njīra ya kūūhurahuria ūkīhūthīra gakerecū.

English: When are rootstocks ready for grafting?
Kikuyu: Nī rī gītina kia mūtī gīkoragwo kīrī gīkinyanīru gīa gūciarithania?

English: The rootstocks is ready for grafting 6 months after transplanting into biodegradable containers (6 X 9 Inches)
Kikuyu: Gītina kīa mūtī gīkinyanagīra gīgūciarithanio mīeri ītandatū thutha wa gūthamio kuuma tutainī na gwīkīrwo mīnyore-inī.

English: When are seedlings ready for transplanting after grafting?
Kikuyu: Nī hīndī īrīkū mīūngūrwa īkoragwo īrī mīkinyu ya kūhandwo thutha wa gūciarithanio?

English: 4 to 6 months later, the seedlings are ready for transplanting into the field and should be well healed and free from pests and diseases
Kikuyu: Thutha wa mīeri īna nginya ītandatū, mīūngūrwa mīciarithanie nīmīkinyanīru ya kūhandwo na ībatiī gūkorwo īrī mīhonu na īgītīirwo kuumana na tūtambi na mīrimū.

English: What is the most preferred time for transplanting of seedlings?
Kikuyu: Nī hīndī īrīkū njega makīria ya kūhanda mīūngūrwa ya mīkorobia?

English: Trees should be planted at the beginning of the seasonal rainfall and as soon as the rain has deeply penetrated the ground
Kikuyu: Mīkorobia yagīrīirwo kūhandwo kīambīrīria-inī kīa mbura ya kīmera na o rīrīa mbura yaringa na yaingīra tīīri-inī wega.

English: What are the factors to keep in mind when transplanting?
Kikuyu: Nī maūndū marīkū magīrīirwo nī kūririkanwo hīndī ya kūhanda mīūngūrwa?

English: The potted plants are carefully removed from their eco-bags in such a way that the soil around the roots is not disturbed.
Kikuyu: Mīnyore ībatiī kūrutwo kahora tīīri ūrīa ūnyitīte mīri ūtegūthīnio.

English: Topsoil mixtures filled into the hole first, followed by the subsoil and firming down.
Kikuyu: Mūtukanio wa tīīri mūnoru wambīrīre gūthika irima, ūcoke ūrūmīrīrwo nī tīīri wa nathī na ūkindīrwo wega.

English: Never plant an Avocado tree deeper than the soil level it was in while in the eco-bag.
Kikuyu: Ndūkahande mūkorobia ūrikīire muno gūkīra ūriku wa harīa ūrakinyīte ūrī mūnyore-inī.

English: After transplanting, the leftover soil is used to build a basin around each tree in order to collect water from rain or irrigation
Kikuyu: Thutha wa kūhanda na kūihūria irima, tīīri ūrīa watigara ūhūthīrwo gūthondeka kīraī gīa kūhīngīrīria maaī hīndī ya mbura kana thutha wa kūhe mūtī maaī.

English: What are the major pest and disease control methods?
Kikuyu: Nīnjīra irīkū irīcia bata makīria cia kūgirīrīria tūtambi na mīrimū?

English: Integrated Crop Management (ICM) is the best option for food safety.
Kikuyu: Mūtukanio wa njīra itiganīte nīyo njīra īrīa njega makīria ya ūgitīīri wa tūtambi na mīrimū.

English: These methods include scouting of pests, field hygiene, proper spacing, physical methods like use of pheromone traps , biological methods and others that will only give option of using pesticides as last option.
Kikuyu: Njīra ici nīhamwe na gūcera mūgūnda-inī ūkīroraga tūtambi na mīrimū, kūiga ūtheru mūgūnda-inī, gūtagania mīkorobia wega hīndī ya kūhanda, ona kūhūthīra mītego ya kūgucīrīria tūtambi, njīra cia kīmerera, na njīra ingī iria iteithagīrīria ūhūthīri wa dawa ūkorwo ūrī ūndū wa mūthia.

English: How is False Codling Moth(FCM) controlled in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Hihi gatambi mūthemba wa False Codling Moth(FCM) kagiragīrīrio atīa mīkorobia-inī.

English: Proper orchard sanitation; Infested fruits (both on the tree and fallen) should be removed regularly (twice a week) and buried 50 cm or dipped in a drum filled with water mixed with used oil for 1 week.
Kikuyu: Ūtheru mwega wa mūgūnda; Matunda marwaru(marī mūtī-inī kana ona magwīte) mabatiī kweherio kaingī(maita merī o wiki) na mathikwo irima rīna ūriku wa 50cm kana maikio thīinī wa ibuba rīihūrītio maaī matukanīte ma oiro kwa ihinda ria wiki īmwe.

English: What are the symptoms of scab in avocado?
Kikuyu: Hihi ndariri cia ironda cia makorobia nīirīkū?

English: Lesions appear as small dark spots slightly raised, oval to elongated.
Kikuyu: Ironda ciambagīrīria kuoneka tarī maroro mairū manini na maimbu, marīna mūhianīre wa ovo ndaihūku.

English: These coalesce, giving a corky appearance to the surface of the fruits-impairing the appearance but not the internal quality of the fruit
Kikuyu: Maroro maya manenehaga, makanyitana na magathondeka kīronda kīnene ngothi-inī mategūthūkia na thīinī.

English: How do i control scab in avocados?
Kikuyu: Ingīhota atīa kūgirīrīria mūrimū wa ironda cia ngothi ya makorobia?

English: Orchard sanitation:
Kikuyu: Ūtheru wa mūgūnda:

English: remove dead branches and twigs since they harbour the fungus.
Kikuyu: eheria honge na ngerecū iria nguū nīūndū ituīkaga mūciī wa tūtambi.

English: remove fallen rotten fruits from the field
Kikuyu: ūngania matunda marīa magwīte.

English: What are the symptoms of anthracnose in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Ndariri cia mūrimū wa anthracnose mīkorobia-inī nīirīkū?

English: Dry spots, dark brown in color, form on the skin, leading to abnormal development.
Kikuyu: Maroro maniaru na mairū methondekaga ngothi-inī ya makorobia na magakūra na mūhianīre ūtarīmwega.

English: In severe attacks, the young fruits drop.
Kikuyu: Mūrimū ūngīneneha, makorobia magūaga marī manini kuuma mūtī-inī.

English: It is mostly a post-harvest disease as the fruits are more susceptible when mature
Kikuyu: Mūrimū ūyū kaingī, ūnyitaga makorobia marīa makūrū na magethetwo.

English: What are the symptoms of Root Rot –Die Back in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Ndariri cia mūrimū wa mīrī kūbutha na honge kūūma mīthia-inī ūrīmi-inī wa makorobia nīirīkū?

English: Trees affected lose vitality, become sparsely foliated and do not produce a good crop.
Kikuyu: Mītī īrīa mīrwaru yagaga hinya wa gūciara, īkaruta mathangū manini na ndīrutaga maciaro maingī.

English: Leaves are pale-green and wilted, branches usually become sunburned and dieback in advanced stages.
Kikuyu: Mathangū magīaga rangi mūhunyūku wa ngirini na makahoha, honge ikahīa nī riūa na īgakua mīthia-inī mūrimū watherema.

English: Feeder roots get darkened and decay and trees will eventually die prematurely
Kikuyu: Mīri īrīa īheyaga mūtī irio īiraga na īkabutha na mūthia mūtī ūkooma ihinda rītarī ikinyu.

English: How do I control root rot die back?
Kikuyu: Ingīhota atīa kūgirīrīria mūrimū wa mīri kūbutha na honge kūūma mīthia-inī?

English: Uprooting of affected trees.
Kikuyu: Kūmunya kwa mītī yoothe mīrwaru.

English: Hot water and fungicide treatment of seeds for propagation.
Kikuyu: Kūhūthīra maaīmahiū na dawa ya kūūraga njamuthi mūthemba wa fungi hīndīya kūharīria mbeū cia kūhanda.

English: Grafting on Phytophthora-tolerant and/or resistant rootstocks.Ridging or raised beds rootstocks
Kikuyu: Gūciarithania itina cia ndūire iria itahotagwo nī mīrimū ta Phytophthora.

English: What are the common pests that affect avocado production?
Kikuyu: Nītūtambi tūrīkū kaingī tūthīnagia mīkorobia?

English: Avocado thrips;Fruit flies;False codling moth;Scales;Red spider mites
Kikuyu: Tūtambi tūtū nī hamwe na thrips, kīhuruta, ngūci, mbūmbūī ndune

English: What are the common diseases that affect hass avocado in Kenya?
Kikuyu: Nī mīrimū īrīkū kaingī īnyitaga mīkorobia mūthemba wa Hass būrūri-inī wa Kenya?

English: Root rot and anthracnose
Kikuyu: Mūrimū wa kūbūthia mīri na anthracnose

English: What are the symptoms of root rot in avocado production and how can it be controlled?
Kikuyu: Nī maūndū marīkū monanagia atī mīri ya mīkorobia nīrabutha na mūrimū ūyū ūngīgirīrīrio atīa?

English: Root rot is a fungal disease that is caused by poorly drained soils and mostly occurs in areas prone to flooding.
Kikuyu: Kūbutha mīri nī mūrimū ūrehagwo nī jamuthi mūthemba wa fungi wonekanaga kūrīa tīīrī ūtaikūrūkagia maaī wega na kūndū kwarahaga maaī thutha wa mbura.

English: Trees have pale-green and wilted leaves and the branches are sunburned and die back.
Kikuyu: Mītī īkoragwo na mathangū ma rangi wa ngirini mūhunyūku na mahohu, na honge ikahīa nī riūa na īgakua mīthia-inī.

English: It is controlled by uprooting affected trees.
Kikuyu: Ūrigagīrīrio gūtherema na njīra ya kūmunya mītī yothe mīrwaru.

English: It can be prevented by keeping trees dry and treating seeds for propagation with hot water and fungicides.
Kikuyu: Ningī ūgiragīrīrio na njīra ya kūiga mītī īrī mīūmū na Kūhūthīra maaī mahiū na dawa ya kūūraga njamuthi mūthemba wa fungi hīndī ya kūharīria mbeū cia kūhanda.

English: What are symptoms of anthracnose in hass avocado and how can it be controlled?
Kikuyu: Ndariri cia mūrimū wa anthracnose mīkorobia-inī ya Hass nīirīkū na ūngīgirīrīrio atia?

English: Anthracnose is a fungal disease that attacks the fruit.
Kikuyu: Mūrimū wa anthracnose ūrīa ūrehagwo nī njamuthi mūthemba wa fungi ūnyitaga matunda.

English: The fruit develops dry, dark brown spots leading to abnormal development.
Kikuyu: Matunda magīaga maroro maniaru na mairū methondekete ngothi-inīya makorobia na magakūra na mūhianīre ūtarīmwega.

English: Mature fruits are most likely to be attacked but young fruits also drop.
Kikuyu: Kaingī matunda marīa makūrū nīmo marwaraga mūno o na gūkorwo marīa manini o namo nīmarwaraga na makagwa kuuma mītī-inī.

English: It is controlled by proper orchard sanitation and use of fungicides.
Kikuyu: Mūrimū ūyū ūrigagīrīrio na njīra ya kūiga mūgūnda ūrī mūtheru na dawa cia kūnina fungi

English: How does false codling moth manifest in avocado?
Kikuyu: Gatambi mūthemba wa kīhuruta kīyonanagia atīa mīkorobia-inī?

English: After emerging from the egg, the young caterpillar tunnels into the fruit and a discoloration appears at the point of entrance.
Kikuyu: Thutha wa kuuma itumbī-inī, kīgūnyū gīthegethaga ikorobia, naguo rangi wa harīa kīaingīrīra ūkagarūrūka.

English: While inside they feed on the pulp, causing premature ripening and fruit drop.
Kikuyu: Ihinda-inī rīu igunyū irī thīinī, irīaga ikorobia igatūma rīruhe tene rītarīikūrū na rīkagwa kuuma mūtī-inī.

English: How does thrips attack manifest itself in avocado?
Kikuyu: Tūtambi mūthemba wa thrips twīyonanagia atīa mīkorobia-inī?

English: These are small, slender insects with two pairs of fringed wings which feed by sucking the plant sap.
Kikuyu: Tūtū nī tūtambi tūnini, tūceke, tūrīna mathagu mana marīna guoya mīthiya-inī na tūnyuaga maaī ma mūmera.

English: They cause damage to the leaves and fruit and the affected parts become whitish or silvery and are usually covered by dark-coloured droppings.
Kikuyu: Twanangaga mathangū na matunda na kūrīa gūothe gūthūkangie gūkagīa na rangi mwerū kana wa betha na kaingī gūkahumbīrwo na kīoro kīrairīrīra.

English: Attacked fruits develop a leathery brown skin and feeding is most common on young fruits.
Kikuyu: Makorobia marīa mahutie magīaga makoni marīna rangi wa gītīīri, ūndū ūyū kaingī wonekaga makorobia-inī marīa manini.

English: How does scale infection manifest itself in avocado?
Kikuyu: Tūtambi mūthemba wa scales twīyonanagia atīa mīkorobia-inī?

English: These are small, stationary brown greenish insects commonly found sucking sap from avocado leaves.
Kikuyu: Tūtū nītūtambi tūnini, tūtaumaga harīa tūrī na twīrangi wa gītīīri na ngirini na kaingī tūnyuaga maaī mathangū-inī ma mīkorobia.

English: The soft scales excrete large amounts of honeydew, which lead to the development of sooty mold on leaves, branches and fruit.
Kikuyu: Tūtambi tūtū tuororo tūtigaga kioro kīingī kīhana ūūkī kīrīa gīcokaga gūcenjia gīkahana mūrarī mathangū-inī, honge-ini na matunda-inī

English: The honeydew also attracts ants. Armored scales may encrust young twigs, leaves and fruit and do not produce honeydew.
Kikuyu: Kīoro gīkī kīhana ūūkī nīkīgūcagīrīria mūthūa. Ngūci noikunīke honge iria nini, mahuti na matunda na hīndī īno itirutaga kīoro.

English: Damage can be serious on young trees and small twigs may be killed.
Kikuyu: Ūgwati no ūnenehe mītī-inī mīnini na honge iria nini no ciūme.

English: Although the presence of scales on the skin of fruit does not cause internal damage, it may lead to rejection of fruit, especially if grown for export.
Kikuyu: O na gūtuīka scales cikaire igūrū wa ikoro itithūkagia thīinī wa ikorobia, no gūtūme makorobia meregwo thoko-inī, na makīria thoko cia rūraya.

English: How is spider mites infection manifested in avocado production?
Kikuyu: Hihi ndariri cia mbūmbūī mīkorobia-inī nīirīkū?

English: Attack by spider mites produces circular necrotic spots covered by dense webbing.
Kikuyu: Tharīkīro ya mbūmbūī yonekaga thutha wa tūcigo tūthiūrūrī tūrabutha tūhumbīrītwo nī nenda cia mbūmbūī kwīyumīria

English: As mite populations increase, feeding causes leaf distortion and eventual drop.he growth of young trees is seriously affected and yields can be reduced significantly.
Kikuyu: O ūrīa mbūmbūī irongerereka ikīrīaga, mathangū nīmekūnjaga na thutha makagūa kuuma mūtī-inī. Mīkorobia īrīa mīnini ndīkūraga wega ona hanini na maciaro no manyihe biū.

English: At what temperature should avocado be pre-cooled?
Kikuyu: Hihi makorobia mabatiī kūigwo kūndū kwīna heho īigana atīa?

English: After harvesting, avocadoes must be cooled as quickly as possible to the optimum storage temperature of 5oC for Fuerte and Hass varieties; within 5 h of harvesting
Kikuyu: Mathaa-inī matano thutha wa kūgethwo, makorobia no mūhaka maigwo kūndū kūrīna heho o naihenya o ūrīa kūngīhoteka ithimo-inī cia 5°C harī mīthemba ya Fuerte na Hass.

English: How should hot water treatment be done?
Kikuyu: Maaī mahiū mahūgathīrwo atīa kūūraga njamuthi?

English: This treatment is used to kill fungal spores on and in the skin of the fruit.
Kikuyu: Maaī mahiū mahūthagīrwo kūūraga mbeū cia njamuthi iria irī igūrū na thīinī wa ikoro rīa ikoribia.

English: The avocados should be immersed in water heated to a temperature of 50°C for 3-5 min.
Kikuyu: Makorobia maikio thīinī wa maaī mahiūhītio kwa gīthimo kīa 50°C na marekwo maikare ndagīka ithatū nginya ithano.

Kikuyu: Nīteithagia marigū na kūhee īrio iria njega nīundu wa mīri yao.

Kikuyu: Mboco nīo mūmera wa omwaka ūrīa ūnyitithanagio na marigū.

Kikuyu: Mīmera īno īrī nīīhotaga gukūra hamwe na mboco ndītoragio nīkīruru kīa marigū kūringithanio na mīmera īrīa īngī

English: Maize and sweet potatoes are intercropped with the young banana plants and are phased out at canopy closure.
Kikuyu: Mbembe na ngwachī nī ihandanagīrio hamwe na marigū nīguo kūgīa kīruru

English: Fruit trees like jack fruit and papaw are established with the plantation as sources of fruit.
Kikuyu: Matunda ta Jack fruit na mababaī mahandagūo marigūinī magatūhe matunda

English: Is it essential for a banana field to have trenches?

English: When is the best time to dig trenches? Can one dig trenches before planting?
Kikuyu: Nī īhīnda rīrīkū rīega rīa kwenja mītaro

Kikuyu: Mītaro yagīrīiruo nī kwenjuo harīa marigū mahandūo nīguo mīmera īrīa mīnini īteithīke nī maaī mau

English: It is ok to dig trenches before planting, but it will be best if you dig them after digging the planting holes.

English: Why is ‘matooke’ from Western Uganda different in taste to that from Central Uganda?
Kikuyu: Nīkīī marigū ma Rūgūrū rwa Uganda marī mūcamo ngūrani na ma Uganda ya gatagatī?

Kikuyu: Mūcamo ūyu ngūrani ūcūngagīrīrio nī maūndū matiganīte ta, mūthemba wa tīri, ūria mbura īraura na ūrīa mūgūnda ūrarorūo

Kikuyu: No nīme marigū hamwe na mananathi?

Kikuyu: Nomarīmwe hamwe mananathi na marigū no angīkoruo marigū nīmo ūtanyate kūrīma mūno tīgīrīra niwatigithūkania wega marima

English: When is the best time to cut off the male bud?

English: How long does a banana take to mature?
Kikuyu: marigū makūraga thutha wa kahinda kaigana atīa?

Kikuyu: marigū makūraga thutha wa mwaka ūmwe kuma ihinda rīa kūhanda matarītuo

English: Is it true that hoes should not be used to control weeds in bananas?
Kikuyu: Nīma atī dībatiī kūhūthīra theci ngīrīma marigū?

Kikuyu: Ti ma

English: However, precaution should be taken when using a hoe to not damage the roots of the bananas.
Kikuyu: No he bata kūmenyerera mīri ya marigū ūkīhūthīra theci

English: Is it okay to spray herbicides in a banana field intercropped with coffee?
Kikuyu: Nī wega kūhuhīra dawa cīa ria mūgūnda inī wa marigū hamwe na kahūa?

Kikuyu: Hatirī thīna angīkorūo dawa īyo nīyahūthīrūo kūringana na ūrīa yedekithītio kuma kūrī athondeki

English: What tools are used to harvest bananas?
Kikuyu: Nī indo īrīkū cibatie kūgetha marigū?

Kikuyu: Mūgūnda-īni wa marigū nī kūrī indo nyīngī cīngīhūthīruo

Kikuyu: Nīkīī kīngīhanīka ūngīgetha marigū matarī meru?

Kikuyu: Nīmabatīe gūkūra wega harī ūraihu na warīe

Kikuyu: Magethagwo tene, matirī mūcamo mwega

English: What are the best practices for fertilizing banana plants?
Kikuyu: Nī atīa wega gūīkīra bataraitha harī marigū?

Kikuyu: Thima tīri nīgūo ūmenye nī bataraitha īrīkū ībataire kūrīngana na maumīrīra ma ūthuthuria

Kikuyu: Nī bataraitha īrīkū njega ībatiī gūīkīruo marigū-inī Kenya?

Kikuyu: ūkīhanda īkīra gramu 200 cia triple super phosphate (TSP) o harī mūmera

Kikuyu: ūhei wa bataraitha ya Nitrogen kabere nī ūteithagia gūkūra kwa naihenya kwa mūmera na gūtūma mīramba īkorūo na hinya

English: What is the best manure for bananas?
Kikuyu: Nī thumu ūrīku mwega wa marigū

English: Organic Grow - If you prefer to start your banana tree off with a high-nitrogen feed then Organic Grow is ideal with an NPK ratio of 7-2-3.
Kikuyu: Organic Grow- ūngītua kwambīrīria mūmera waku na nitrogen nyingī, ūhe Organic Grow īrīa īri na NPK gīthimo kīa 7-2-3

English: Organic Bloom - With an NPK ratio of 6-5-6, Organic Bloom will ensure your banana plants has everything it needs throughout the growing season.
Kikuyu: Organic Bloom- īrī na gīthimo kīa 6-5-6, Organic bloom ītigagīrīra marigū maku mena irio iria ībatiī kīmera gīothe

English: What is the recommended fertilizer and Manure to apply banana?
Kikuyu: Nī bataraitha na thumu ūrīkū wendekithītio?

English: At planting, about 200 g of triple super phosphate (TSP) should be applied per plant.
Kikuyu: ūkīhanda rī, hūthīra ta gramu 200 cia Super phosphate TSP mūmera inī.

English: An early and good supply of nitrogen fertilizer is essential to accelerate the growth of pseudo-stems and faster flowering.
Kikuyu: ūheo wa tene na wanaihenya wa bataraitha ya Nitrogen wī bata harī kūhiūhia ūkūria wa narua wa mūmera

English: To 300 g of calcium ammonium nitrate (CAN) should be distributed around each stool per year, together with 125 g of TSP, which is worked into the soil.
Kikuyu: Gramu 300 cia Calcium Ammonium Nitrate CAN ūbatie gwītirīrio gītina-inī harī o mwaka hamwe na gramu 125 cia TSP nīguo kūruta wīra tīīrī- inī

English: Two to four debes of decomposed farmyard manure is applied per stem per year before the rains.
Kikuyu: Debe 2- 4 cia thumu nīciheagūo mūmera harī o mwaka mbura īta naura

English: This is applied on the outer diameter of the canopy.
Kikuyu: īka ūū haraihu na gītina-inī

English: A short forked hoe is used to incorporate the manure shallowly and carefully, to ensure no root damage.
Kikuyu: Hūma nini īteithagia gūtukania thumu wega na tīri na kūgitīra gūthūkīa mīri

English: Does mulching control banana weevils?
Kikuyu: Hihi kwarīra marigū nī kūgiragīrīria gūtamba kwa mboca cia marīgu?

English: No, mulching does not control banana weevils.
Kikuyu: Aca, Kwarīra marigū gūtigiragīrīria gūtamba kwa mboca cia marīgu

Kikuyu: Makīrīa, nī kuongerera ūciarithanio wacio tondū nīutethagia gucīhe handū hega ha gūciarana

English: This is why it is not recommended to apply mulch close to the banana plant.
Kikuyu: Nīkīo tī wega kwarīra hakuhī na mīmera ya marigū

English: Can a farmer who mulches his plantation but does not apply fertilizers obtain big bunches?
Kikuyu: Hihi mūrīmi waragira mīmera yake mūcing'i na ndaheaga bataraitha no agīe honge nene?

English: A farmer could still get quite big bunches, but they would be bigger if fertilizer was also used.
Kikuyu: No agīe honge nene, no agīe nene makīria angīhūthīra bataraitha

English: The best bunches are produced where all the recommended agronomic practices are carried out, including both mulching and applying fertilizer.
Kikuyu: Honge njega cigīagūo ūngīrūmīrīra mendekithia mothe ta kwarīra mīmera yaku hamwe na kuhe bataraitha

English: As mulching conserves water in the soil, is it also necessary to dig trenches in a mulched banana
Kikuyu: Kwarīra marigū gūteithagia kūnyihia kūra kwa maaī, harī bata kwenja mītaro harīa warīīre

English: If there is water flowing through the field, the trenches are needed even if the field is mulched.
Kikuyu: Okorūo Harī maaī maragera mūgūnda inī, mītaro nī ībatiī onangīkorūo niwarīire mūgūnda waku

English: Mulching and trenches have different roles:
Kikuyu: Kwarīra na kwenja mītaro nīrī mawira ngūrani

English: mulching conserves water in the soil, whereas the trenches trap the water within the field and also stop topsoil from being eroded.
Kikuyu: Kwarīra kūgitagīrīria maaī marīa marī tīri-inī , mītaro nayo ītegaga maaī marīa marī mūgūnda na ougūo kūgītīra tīri wa igūrū

English: Which is better for banana production: chicken or cow manure?
Kikuyu: Nī thumu ūrīku mwega mūgūnda īnī wa marigū?

English: Both types of manure are good, and the type of manure you use depends on availability.
Kikuyu: Mīthemba yothe ya thumu nī mīega na ūkīhūthīra o mūthemba nī kūraringana na woneku waguo

English: However, chicken manure is used up faster than cow manure, so cow manure is better from that point of view.
Kikuyu: Harī o ugūo rī, thumu wa ngūkū nī ūhūthīkaga narua makīria gukīra wa ng'ombe, koguo wa ng'ombe nī mwega makīria

English: How can I tell fake fertilizers from genuine fertilizers?
Kikuyu: ingī kūrana atīa bataraitha njega harī njūrū

English: The only way is to buy fertilizers from a reputable agro-input dealer or company.
Kikuyu: Njīra njega no kūgūra bataraitha yaku harī mwendia ūīkaine weega kuma kambūni njega?

English: What is the maximum amount of organic fertilizers recommended for a banana plant?
Kikuyu: Nī gīkīro kīrīkū batie kūhe bataraitha ya kīmerera harī mūmera wa marigū?

English: Is it possible to ‘overdose’ with organic fertilizers, as is the case with inorganic ones?
Kikuyu: No kūhoteke atī nīndakīria gīthimo kīa bataraitha ya kīmerera?

Kikuyu: Aca, gūkīria gīthimo nī hinya. Harī o ugūo arīmī nī mabatīe gūīthema gūīkīra makīria nīguo kūgirīrīria gūthūkangia

English: For bananas, apply only two basins (~ 20 kg) of organic manure at the beginning of the rains.
Kikuyu: Harī marigū, īkīra irai igirī (kilo 20) cia thumu mbura īkīambia

English: Is there any relationship between nutrient deficiency and diseases in bananas?
Kikuyu: Nī harī ūndū ūnyitithanagia wagi wa irio na mīrīmū harī marigū?

English: Yes, there is a big relationship.
Kikuyu: īī nī harī

English: Bananas that lack some nutrients are stressed and are much more easily attacked by diseases.
Kikuyu: marigū marīa magaga mūthemba wa irio nīmagūmagīrūo nī mīrīmū mūno

English: Can nutrient deficiency weaken the bananas?
Kikuyu: Hihi, kwaga irio harī mūmera nogūtūme mūmera kwaga hinya?

English: Yes, nutrient deficiency weakens the bananas and also leads to poor harvest.
Kikuyu: īī nigūo, wagi wa irio no gūtūme mūmera wage hinya na mwisho wage maciaro mega

English: How do I market my bananas in Kenya?
Kikuyu: Ngwetha atīa thoko ya marigū makwa Kenya?

English: You can sell bananas in local markets, to fruit vendors, or export them.
Kikuyu: No wendie marigū kūrī thoko nini, endia a matunda kana nja ya būrūri

English: Building relationships with buyers and cooperatives can help access markets.
Kikuyu: Gūthondeka ūnyitanīri wa agūri na honge cia ūgūri nī iteithagia kūona thoko.

English: How can I control banana weevils on my farm?
Kikuyu: īngīnyihia atīa mboca cia marīgu mūgūnda-inī wakwa?

English: Control measures include using healthy planting materials, proper sanitation, and applying appropriate pesticides when necessary.
Kikuyu: Njīra cia kugīrīrīria nī hamwe na, kūhūthīra Indo therū na kūhuthīra dawa cia tūtambi īria ibatie rīrīa kūbatiī.

English: What is Panama disease, and how can it be managed?
Kikuyu: Mūrimū wa Panama nī ūrīkū na ūngīrorūo atīa?

English: Panama disease is a devastating fungal disease.
Kikuyu: Mūrimū wa Panama nī mūrimū mūru wa marigū

English: Management includes planting resistant varieties and maintaining strict sanitation practices.
Kikuyu: Gūthaitīra nī hamwe na kuhanda mbeu iria hetūkie na cīngīītiria mīrīmū hamwe na kūrora ūtheru wa mūgūnda

English: How do I prevent diseases like Black Sigatoka in my banana plantation?
Kikuyu: īngīgitia atīa mūrimū ta Black Sigatoka mūgūnda inī wakwa wa Marigū

Kikuyu: Kūmenyerera mūgūnda nī hamwe kūhūra dawa cia fungicide na gūtigīrīra kūrī na ūtheru wa mūgūnda. gwīka ūū nī gūkūgirīrīria Black Sigatoka

English: How can I improve my banana plantation?
Kikuyu: ingīagīria atīa makīria mūgūnda wakwa wa Marigū?

Kikuyu: Harī mūgunda mwega, tīgīrīra tīri nī mūtheru

English: apply fertilizers;
Kikuyu: Gītira mūmera kumana na ndwari na tūtambi

English: prune the plants;
Kikuyu: Rūnga mīmera yaku

English: prevent the plants from falling;
Kikuyu: Gitīra mūmera dūkagūe

English: look after the fruit;
Kikuyu: Rora matunda

English: How do you control pests in banana plantation?
Kikuyu: ūgiragīrīria atīa tūtambi na mīrīmū mūgūnda inī wa marigū?

English: Chemical Control Spray soapy water or insecticidal soap on plants thoroughly on petioles, furled leaves, whorls or on young suckers.
Kikuyu: Dawa cīa kūhuthīra-Huhīra maaī ma thabuni kana thabuni wa tūtambi harī mīmera wega harī petiols, mathangū makūnjīkanu, whorls kana kūrī thuna iria nini

English: Spray Dimethoate (75ml/100lit) or Diazinon (1.5ml/lit) or Acephate (1.3g/lit) on infested plants and suckers.
Kikuyu: Huhīra Dimethoate ( 75ml/100ltr) kana Diazinon( 1.5ml/ltr) kana Acephate ( 1.3g/ ltr) harī mīmera kana thuna iria ng'umīre.

English: Spray Methyl Demeton 25 EC 0.05%
Kikuyu: Huhīra Methyl Demeton 25EC 0.05%

English: What is a major problem with banana plantations?
Kikuyu: Nīkīī thīna makīria harī mīgūnda ya marigū?

English: The major environmental problems arise from the production of bananas for export or from large-scale commercial production of bananas for local markets.
Kikuyu: Thīna mūnene harī ūkūria wa marigū maingī na ma naja wa būrūri kana gūkūria nīūndū wa thoko cia o gūkū būrūri-inī

English: These include habitat conversion, soil erosion and degradation, pollution from agrochemical use, solid waste, and water usage.
Kikuyu: Nī hamwe na gūcejia harīa makūragio, tīri kwenyūka na gūthūka, gūtukanīka na dawa iria ihuhagīrio, guteo gwa takataka na maaī

English: What is a Banana weevil (Cosmopolites sordidus)
Kikuyu: Mbocha cia marigū nīkīī (Cosmopolites Sordidus)

English: The Banana weevil is a very damaging banana root borer.
Kikuyu: Mboca cia marīgu nī ithūkagia na gūtūra marima mīri-inī

English: The larvae bore into corms, suckers, and roots and lead to extensive root destruction.
Kikuyu: Kīgunyū nīkīo gītūraga mīkori, na mīri na īgatūma mīri īthūke.

English: This leads to stunted plant growth and eventually premature toppling of the plants and plant death.
Kikuyu: Nī ītumaga marigū mekururie gūkūra na mwisho makambia kūgwa na gūkua mūmera wothe

English: How to manage Banana weevil (Cosmopolites sordidus)
Kikuyu: ūngīgirīrīria atīa gūtamba kwa mboca cia marīgū

English: Recommendations to farmers for management of the banana weevil:
Kikuyu: Wendekīthia kūrī arīmī nī hamwe na:

English: > Use clean planting materials - As mentioned earlier, use tissue culture plantlets or treated suckers for planting new banana plantations.
Kikuyu: Hūthīra Indo therū ūkīhanda - Handa mīmera ītarī na mīrīmū.

English: > Crop rotation - In heavily infested gardens, it is highly recommended to progressively destroy the entire garden and remove all banana plants and their corms.
Kikuyu: > Garūra mīmera - He bata kūmunya marigū mothe mīgūnda-inī īrīa mīgūmīre nī tūtambi n mīrimū na ūhande mīmera mūthemba ūngī.

English: Chop them to dry or compost them and plant other crops in the field for 1 to 2 years.
Kikuyu: Tinangia mīramba iyo nīguo ithondeke thumu na ūhande mīmera īngī harī mwaka ūmwe nginya īrī

English: Make sure that all corms and roots are destroyed during that time.
Kikuyu: Tīgīrīra mbeū na mīrI yothe nī yathūkio

English: > Ensure field hygiene - It is a common practice to split the pseudostem after every harvest.
Kikuyu: ūtheru wa mūgūnda- he bata kūrenga mūramba o wagetha

English: The stem is split open and the sheaths are spread out to dry so that weevil eggs and larvae are destroyed.
Kikuyu: Muramba ūrengaguo nīguo matūmbī ma mboca macinūo na mathūke

English: The sheaths should, however, be laid about 2 feet away from the banana stool, like any other mulching material in a banana plantation.
Kikuyu: Mīramba ībatiī kūigūo fiti īgīrī haraihu na gītina kīa marigū ota ūrīa gwīkagūo harī kwarīra mīmera īrīa īngī.

English: Do not move banana residue material (pseudostems, corms, sheaths) from one field to another in order to limit transmission of weevils.
Kikuyu: Matigio ma marigū matibatie kūrutūo mūgūnda inī nginya ūngī nīgūo kūgirīrīria gūtamba kwa mboca

English: > Trap the weevils - Laying traps to catch banana weevils and killing the weevils collected from traps can be an effective method of controlling weevils especially in small gardens.
Kikuyu: Tega mboca- Iga mītego yaku nīguo kūnyitia mboca cia marīgū na gūciūraga nīguo kūnyihia gūtherema harī mīgūnda mīnini.

English: The weevils are mobile at night and can be trapped by baiting the field with slices of banana pseudostems.
Kikuyu: Mboca nī ithiaga mūno ūtukū koguo no cīarīrwo mītego harī marigū matinangie weega.

English: Traps should be cleared every 3 days so that they do not become a breeding ground for the weevils.
Kikuyu: mītego īyo ībatiī kweherio thutha wa thīkū ithatū nīguo kūgirīrīria gūcīarana makīrīa.

English: All trapped weevils should be picked from the baits and destroyed or fed to poultry.
Kikuyu: Mboca iria cianyitūo cibatīe kweherio mītego-inī kana iheo ngūkū kana nyoni.

English: > Keep the banana stool clean - Mulching materials or any debris should not be put close or within the stool in order to deny weevils a hiding place.
Kikuyu: Tigīrīra gītinainī kīa marigū nī gītheru, arīra haraihu na gītīna nīgūo kūgiria mboca gūcīarana

English: Also, any banana plant remains from infected gardens should not be used as mulch in clean banana gardens.
Kikuyu: Oūgūo rī, matigari mūmera wa marigū o wothe harī mūgūnda mūrwaru ndūbatie kūhūthīrūo kwarīra mīmera ya marigū harī mūgunda ūngī

English: > Use natural pesticides - Such as wood ash, tephrosia leaf dust, chilli preparations with animal urine, tithonia leaf extract, and neem oil.
Kikuyu: Hūthīra dawa cīa tūtambī cia kīmerera - ta muhu, rūkūngū rwa tephrosia, biribiri, mathugumo ma mahiū, mahuti ma tithonia na maguta ma neem.

English: These materials should be applied at the base of the plants around the stool and around infected pseudostems.
Kikuyu: Indo ici cibatie gūīkīrūo gītinainī kīa mūmera mwena-inī ūrīa mūgūmīre

English: However, it is important for certified organic farmers to check with their certification body before using any factory-made products for weevil control.
Kikuyu: Harī oūguo rī, he bata harī arīmi a kīmerera kūrora indo cīumīte igandainī nīguo kūgirīrīria gūtamba kwa mboca

English: What are Nematodes
Kikuyu: Mīnyongoro nī kī?

English: • Nematodes are the most damaging pests causing over 70 % loss of the crop Damages:

Kikuyu: Nigūo gūciara makīria tīgīthania na 1.2m x 1.5m

English: High Density Planting : High density planting is in practice to accommodate 4444 to 5555 plants per ha
Kikuyu: High density nī kūhanda itina 4444-5555 hactare-inī īmwe

English: Which month is best for banana plantation?
Kikuyu: Nī mweri ūrīkū mwega wa kūhanda marigū?

English: Bananas planted in March/April made better growth and gave higher yields than those planted upto December.
Kikuyu: marigū mahandituo mweri wa gatatū/kana nimakūraga wega na gūcīara wega makīria kūrī marīa mahandītuo thutha ūcio nginya Dithemba

English: Flowering occurred in less than 300 days after planting in March/April.
Kikuyu: Marigū marutaga kīro thutha wa thīkū 300 thutha wa kūhanda mwerī-inī wa gatatū/kana

English: Growth and flower bud differentiation and fruit development were adversely affected, when the average temperature was below 750 F
Kikuyu: Kūruta kīro na gūciara nīigomagīruo rīrīa ikīro cia rūgarī irī thīī wa 750F

English: Can you plant banana trees next to each other?
Kikuyu: No ūhande marīgū hakuhī na mītī īngī?

English: Keep at least 2 to 3 meter gap between 2 plants. Also keep good mulch around the base , so that new root growth should not start new shoots until you want them.
Kikuyu: Mītīgithūkanie na 2m -3m kuuma mūtī nginya irigū-inī. Tīgīrīra nī warīra mūcing'i gītina-inī nīguo mīrī mīerū ndīgathune nginya rīrīa ūkwnda.

English: Establishing a new banana garden?
Kikuyu: Uthondekaga atīa mūgūnda mweru wa marigū?

English: A site with deep, well-drained and fertile soils, preferably rich in organic matter is good for banana production.
Kikuyu: Marigū mekaga wega nandū harī na tīīrī mūriku, uraikūrūkia wega maaī na mūnoru

English: It will encourage the development of strong plants that can tolerate infections.
Kikuyu: Nīgūteithagia mūmera kūgia hinya na guītirīa mīrīmū

English: A newly opened land without signs or history of nematodes or the devastating Fusarium wilt and bacterial wilt diseases is preferred.
Kikuyu: Mūgūnda mwerū ūtarī na mīnyongoro kana mīrimū mīūru ya kūhoha, Fusarium wilt na bacterial wilt, nīwendetwo

English: If the site has been used for production of bananas in the last two years, it is highly recommended to remove all remaining banana plants and corms.
Kikuyu: Angīkorwo mūgūnda ūcio nīwarīmītwo marigū mīaka īrī mīhītūku, nīwega weherio marigū marīa matiga hamwe na thuna

English: Normally such remnants harbour a lot of pests and diseases.
Kikuyu: Matigari mau mahithaga tūtambi na mīrimū.

English: The remnants should be transferred into another field (not of bananas), chopped and spread to dry or composted.
Kikuyu: Matigari mau mabatīe meherio mūgūnda-inī na matwaro kūngī, matinangio na manīkuo nīguo mome

English: The land should then be planted with a legume crop (like beans) or left to follow with a legume green manure cover crop for 1 to 2 years.
Kikuyu: Mūgūnda ūcio nī ubatie ūhanduo mboco kana ūtiguo ūguo kwa ihinda rīa mwaka 1 nginya 2

English: This will ensure that any remaining pest or disease infections are completely removed before introducing new banana plants.
Kikuyu: Gūika ūū nīgūtigagīrīra tūtambi na mīrīmū yothe nīyeherio ūtanahada marigū merū.

English: All perennial weeds should also be removed and destroyed before planting because bananas are very susceptible to weed competition.
Kikuyu: Ria rīothe rībatiī rīeherio ūtanahada nīūndū marigū nīmatoragio nī ria

English: Some of the existing trees at the selected site should be left during land clearing in order to protect the young banana plants from wind and strong direct sunshine
Kikuyu: ūgītheria mūgūnda wa marigū tigīa mītī mīnini ya kūhinga rūhuho rūnene na rīua kūhe marigū kīruru marī manini.

English: What is banana tissue culture?
Kikuyu: Marīgu ma mūciarithanio nī marīkū?

English: Tissue culture is a technique for multiplying clean banana planting material from small plant pieces taken from a mother plant.
Kikuyu: īno nī njīra ya gūciarithania marīgū kuuma marigū-inī manini marutītwo kuuma kūrī mangī makūrū.

English: Although any part of the banana plant can be used to generate tissue culture plants, it is the meristem/shoot tip that is commonly used
Kikuyu: Ona angīkorūo gacunjī o gothe ka irigū no kahūthīke gūcīarithania nī thuna īhūthīkaga

English: How to produce tissue culture banana plantlets
Kikuyu: ūngīthondeka atīa marīgū ma mūciarithanio?

English: 1. Carefully select source materials (peepers or small sword suckers) that appear healthy (pest- and disease-free) and that are growing vigorously. [Trainer: Show two suckers to the participants: one that has visible evidence of pest or disease infestation and one that appears healthy. Explain that you cannot be sure if you are planting infected or clean material, as most suckers appear to be relatively healthy until their corms are exposed.]
Kikuyu: 1. Thura wega marigū maria ūgūciarithania matarī na mīrimū na tūtambi na marakūra narua. Onia arutuwo thuna ciothe, īmwe īrīa irī na mūrimū na īngī itarī. Matarīrie atī ndūngīkoruo na ūma kana nī mūrwaru kana ndūri mūrimu tondu thuna nyingī cionekaga īrī njega nginya rīrīa corms ikuoneka.

English: 2. Using either a hoe or a panga, separate the sucker (‘ex-plant’) from the mother plant.
Kikuyu: 2. ūkīhūthīra icembe kana banga, tīgīthūkanīa thuna iria irendeka na mūramba

English: 3. Clean the sucker by removing soil and cutting off the roots to expose the corm.
Kikuyu: 3. Thambia thuna ukīruta tīīri na ūtīnie mīrī nīgūo corms cioneke.

English: Cut off parts of the pseudostem to a length of about 30 cm
Kikuyu: Renga mūramba ūtigie sentimita 30.

English: 4. Pack the pseudostem parts in a clean nylon bag and transport them to a cleaner environment for further manipulation.
Kikuyu: 4. Banga īcunjī icio cia mūramba karatathi-inī ka munyore gatheru na ūcithamie nginya handū hangī hatheru.

English: 5. Wash the sucker under tap water to remove mud and other debris.
Kikuyu: 5. Thambia thuna nīguo weherie ndoro na gīko kīngī.

English: 6. Trim away the outer leaf sheaths, leaf bases and corm tissue of the ex-plant until a 2 × 2 × 2 cm3 cube enclosing the shoot apex remains.
Kikuyu: 6. Eheria mathangū mothe manathī, na ūrenge mūrita wa corm ūtigīe ūrī na ithimo cia 2cmx2cmx2cm ūnyitanīte na mūthia wa thuna.

English: Be careful to avoid cutting through the apex.
Kikuyu: Menyerera ndūkarenge mūthia wa thuna

English: 7. The ex-plant is placed directly on a multiplication-inducing culture medium in containers.
Kikuyu: 7. iga mūmera ūcio wa mbere wagūciarithania thīīni wa tūmīkebe

English: A growth regulator (cytokinin) is added to the multiplication medium to speed up the process.
Kikuyu: Nigūo kūhanyūkia gūkūra nīyongagīrīruo cytokinin

English: The containers are transferred to incubators or growth chambers and maintained at an optimal growth temperature of 28 ± 2°C. 8.
Kikuyu: Mīkebe īyo īcoke īigwo thīinī wa incubators na ūrugarī wūigwo ūrī digirii 28 na ndūgakūre kana kūingīha na makīria ma digirii 2.

English: Banana tissue culture shoots often suffer from blackening caused by exudates from wounded tissues.
Kikuyu: mīthia ya thuna cia marigū ma mūciarithanio nī majitagwo nī mūrimū wa kūira nī iria kuuma guraro-inī.

English: These undesirable exudates form a barrier round the tissue, preventing nutrient uptake and hindering growth.
Kikuyu: Iria rīrī rītarendeka rīthondekaga thingo iria igiragia thuna kūria irio na igatūma ciīkururie mūkūrīre-inī.

English: To prevent this, during the first 4–6 weeks fresh shoots are transferred to new medium every 1–2 weeks.
Kikuyu: Nigūo kūgīrīrīria, wiki cia mbere 4-6, thuna njerū nīicenjagio thutha wa wiki 1-2

English: 9. The shoot tips then start to develop.
Kikuyu: Thuna ici nacio ikambīrīria gūkūra

English: 10.Individual shoots or shoot clumps that have formed are transferred to a nutrient medium which does not promote further shoot proliferation but stimulates root formation (rooting media).
Kikuyu: Thuna kana ga kahīri gacio karīa gethondekete icokaga igathamīrio irio-inī itarareka thuna ingī ciīongerere no irateithia mīri īthondeke.(irio cia mīri)

English: After rooting, plantlets are ready to leave the laboratory for weaning and hardening.
Kikuyu: Thutha wa kūruta mīrī, mīmera īyo noīrutwo laboratory nīguo yūmīrīrie

English: Is it okay to establish a banana orchard using suckers derived from tissue culture plants?
Kikuyu: Ni wega kūiga natharī ya marigū ya thuna ciumanite na marigū ma mūciarithanio?

English: Yes, it is ok and there are several people who sell suckers from orchards that were started using tissue culture plants.
Kikuyu: īī no wūige, nī kūri andu mendagia thuna icio ciumanite na marigū ma mūciarithanio

English: However, suckers derived from tissue culture plants are just like any other suckers, and not pest- and disease-free.
Kikuyu: Ona kūrī oūguo rī, thuna ciumanite na marigū ma mūciarithanio no ta thuna iria ingi kwoguo nīigumagīrwo nī mīrimū na tūtambi o ta thuna iria īngī

English: How long do tissue culture plants take to mature and fruit?
Kikuyu: Hihi marigū ma mūciarithanio maikaraga kahinda kaigana atīa gūkūra?

English: If a tissue culture plant is managed very well, it will always fruit and mature faster than an ordinary sucker.
Kikuyu: Mūmera wa gūcīarithanio ūngīrorwo wega no ūciare na ūkūre narua gūkīra marigū ma kawaida ma thuna

English: Usually, this takes 9–12 months after planting.
Kikuyu: Kaingī ihūthagīra mīeri 9-12 itanahandwo

English: For how long does a banana field established using banana tissue plantlets last?
Kikuyu: Mūgūnda uhandītwo marigū ma mūciarithanio maikaraga kahinda kaigana atīa?

English: How long a banana plantation lasts depends on the level of management, and is the same whether started with tissue culture plantlets or other planting material.
Kikuyu: Mūgūnda wa marigū ūhūthīkaga kahinda karaihu kūringana na ūria ūroretwo na nī ūndū ūmwe onakorwo ūhandītwo na njīra ngūrani.

English: A well-managed plantation should last for a minimum of 10 years.
Kikuyu: Mūgūnda ūroretwo wega no wūikare mīaka ītanyihīīre ikūmi.

English: Are suckers from tissue culture plant also called tissue culture plants?
Kikuyu: Hihi thuna kuma mūti wa mūciarithanio no ciīrwo nī cia mūciarithanio?

English: No. When a tissue culture plantlet is planted into the field, all the suckers it produces thereafter are not tissue culture plants, they are ordinary suckers.
Kikuyu: Aca, marigū ma mūciarithanio mahandwo mūgūnda-inī, thuna īria īkūruta ti cia mūciarithanio nī thuna cia kawaida.

English: Can all banana cultivars be produced using banana tissue culture technology?
Kikuyu: marigū no makūrio na njīra ya mūciarithanio?

English: Yes, all banana cultivars can be produced using tissue culture technology.
Kikuyu: īī marigū no makūrio na njīra īno ya mūciarithanio

English: However, the management of a tissue culture laboratory will first assess the commercial potential of a demanded cultivar to ensure profits.
Kikuyu: Niguo gutungata marigū ma mūciarithanio, he bata kurora thoko ūrīa īhana nīguo gūtigīrīra baita nīkuoneka

English: What is the standard size of a planting hole?
Kikuyu: īrima rīa kūhanda marigū rīagīrīire kwenjwo rīigana atīa?

English: The size of the planting hole depends on many factors including soil type, soil texture, etc.
Kikuyu: Thaithi ya irima ūringanaga na maūndū ngūrani; mutheba wa tīīrī, ūnyoroku wa tīīrī hamwe na maundū mangī

English: It is common practice to dig a hole measuring 45 cm × 45 cm × 45 cm.
Kikuyu: Nī ūndū wīkīkaga kwenja irima rīīgana 45cmx45cmx45cm

English: If intercropping banana and coffee, when is it best to demarcate the planting holes for coffee?
Kikuyu: Angīkorwo nī kūhanda marigū na kahūa, nī īhinda rīrīku riega rīa gūthura harīa marīma ma kahūa makwenjwo?

English: It is best to plan and demarcate the planting holes for both coffee and banana at the same time.
Kikuyu: Nī wega kūgayūkania harīa marima ma kahūa na marigū makwenjwo hamwe

English: Should the planting holes be dug and manure applied on the same day?
Kikuyu: Nī wega kwenja marima na gūikīra thumu hamwe mūthenya ūmwe?

English: And can the bananas be planted on the same day?
Kikuyu: Na marigū no mahandwo mūthenya ūcio?

English: It is fine to dig the planting hole and apply manure at the same time.
Kikuyu: Hatirī thīna kwenja irima rīa kūhanda na gūikīra thumu hamwe

English: Whether you can also plant on the same day depends on the manure you are using.
Kikuyu: harī kūhanda mūthenya ūcio nī kūringanaga na mūthemba wa thumu

English: If the manure is very well dried and well mixed with the topsoil, then it is okay to plant on the same day
Kikuyu: Angīkoruo thumu ni mūniaru wega na ūgatukanio wega na tīri, ni wega kūhanda mūthenya ūcio

English: For how long should I water the banana plantlet after planting?
Kikuyu: Njagīrīire gūitīīrīria maaī kamūmera ka marigū thikū cīgana thutha wa kūhanda

English: The best practice is to water until the plantlet starts developing new leaves.
Kikuyu: wega nigūitīīrīria nginya mūmera wambie kūruta mathangū merī

English: However, you do not have to keep watering if it is raining sufficiently.
Kikuyu: Ona kūrī ūguo angīkorwo nī kūraura wega ndūbatīe gūitīīrīria maaī rīngī

English: What is the significance of applying mulch around the newly planted bananas?
Kikuyu: He bata ūrīku wa kwarīra marigū manini?

English: This is done to prevent water loss.
Kikuyu: Gwika ūguo nīguo kūgirīrīria kūra kwa maaī

English: As the plantlets are fragile immediately after planting, if they dry out they can become damaged or die.
Kikuyu: Tondū mīmera īno nī minini no yūme, īthūke kana īkue

English: When is the best time to plant the bananas – is it in the middle of the rainy season or at the onset?
Kikuyu: Nī ihinda rīrīku rīega rīa kūhanda marigū- nī gatagatīini wa mbura kana itambītie?

English: The best time to plant bananas is at the onset of the rainy season.
Kikuyu: Ihinda rīega makīrīa rīa kūhanda marigū nī rīrīa mbura īhakuhī kura

English: This means that you have to have the field prepared (planting holes dug and manure applied into the holes) before the rains start.
Kikuyu: ūū nī kuuga no nginya ūharīrīrie mūgūnda mbere (kwenja marima na gūīkīra thumu marīma-ini) mbura ītaurīte.

English: Would you recommend intercropping banana and maize?
Kikuyu: No wendekīthie kūhanda mbembe na marigū hamwe?

English: It is not recommended to intercrop maize and banana since maize will compete with bananas for light.
Kikuyu: Ndūtarītuo kūhanda mbembe na marigū hamwe tondū nīitharanaga ūtheri wa rīua.

English: Also, unlike crops that fix nitrogen in the soil, for example beans, maize does not add any nutrients into the soil.
Kikuyu: Mbembe ititeithagia kuongerera nitrogen tīīrī-inī ūndū ūria mboco ciakaga.

English: Why is it that in the past (20 years ago) banana fields lasted longer than they do today?
Kikuyu: Nīkīi gīatūmaga miaka 20 mīhetūku mīgūnda ya marīgū yaikaraga kahinda karaihu gūkīra rīu?

English: There could be several reasons to explain why banana fields used to last longer in the past, such as less disease pressure (e.g. diseases like Xanthomonas wilt were not yet present), soil fertility was not as depleted as it is currently, and global warming was not as intense as it is now.
Kikuyu: Nogūkoruo na itūmi nyingī ingītwīra nīkīī mūgūnda wa marigū wahūthīkaga kahinda karaihu mīaka ya thutha; mīrīmū yarī mīnini, (mūrimū ta Xanthomonas wilt ndīarīkuo) tīīrī warī mūnoru gukīra rīu na ūrūgarī dwarī mūingi.

English: But if you take care of your banana field it should last for 10 years.
Kikuyu: No angīkoruo nīūgutungata mūgūnda waku, marigū moyaga mīaka ikūmī

English: Can bananas be grown in swampy areas?
Kikuyu: marigū no mahanduo gītuamba-inī kīri na maaī?

English: Yes, they can be grown in swampy areas, as long as the soil is not waterlogged for long periods.
Kikuyu: īī, no mahanduo gītuamba-inī angīkoruo tīīrī ndūgūikara na maaī kahinda karaihu

English: What are the key steps in post-harvest handling of bananas?
Kikuyu: Nī makinya marīkū ubatīe kūrūmīriīra thutha wa kūgetha?

English: Post-harvest handling includes careful harvesting, proper packaging, and storage in a cool, well-ventilated area to extend shelf life.
Kikuyu: ūkīgetha, getha ūbacīrīīre, banga na ūige marīgū maku handū harī rīera rīracera wega nīguo maikare kahinda karaihu.

English: How far apart should I space banana plants in my plantation?
Kikuyu: Batīe gūtigithūkania atīa mīmera ya marīgū mūgūnda-inī wakwa?

English: The recommended spacing is usually 2.5 meters between rows and 2 meters between individual banana plants. Some varieties require 3 x 3 or 3 x 2m.
Kikuyu: Gūtigithūkanio kūrīa kwendekithītio nī kwa mita 2.5 kuuma laini nginya īngī na mita 2 kuuma mūmera-inī ūmwe nginya ūrīa ūngī. Nī harī mīthemba ībataraga 3mx3m kana 3mx2m

English: What would you recommend and why: cooking or roasting types?
Kikuyu: Ūngīendekithia atīa na nīkī: Kūruga kana gūcina?

English: This totally depends on the farmer’s interest.
Kikuyu: Ūū kūraringana na wendi wa mūrīmi

English: The management practices are the same.
Kikuyu: Ūtungata nī ūhanaine

English: What are the common pests that affect banana plants in Kenya?
Kikuyu: Nī tūtambi tūrīkū twa marigū tūīkaine makīrīa būrūri-inī wa Kenya?

English: Common banana pests in Kenya include banana weevils, nematodes, aphids, thrips, and spider mites.
Kikuyu: Tūtambi twa marigū būrūri-inī wa Kenya nī hamwe na mboca cia marigū, mīnyongoro, ūme, thrips na mbumbuī.

English: Are there banana varieties resistant to Black Sigatoka in Kenya?
Kikuyu: Hihi mīthemba ya marigū nīītiragia mūrimū wa Black Sigatoka būrūri-inī wa Kenya?

English: Yes, some banana varieties, such as FHIA-17 and FHIA-23, have shown resistance to Black Sigatoka.
Kikuyu: īī, mīthemba ya marigū ta FHIA-17 na FHIA-23, yonanītie gwitīria na Black Sigatoka.

English: How often should I irrigate my banana plantation?
Kikuyu: Hihi batīī gūitīīrīria marigū maaī maita maigana?

English: The frequency of irrigation depends on local conditions, but bananas generally require regular watering, especially during dry periods.
Kikuyu: Maita marīa ūngīitīīrīrīa maaī kūringanaga na maundu matiganīte, o na kūri ūguo, marigū nīmabataraga maaī kaingī makīria hīndī ya riūa.

English: Would you recommend a farmer to water his or her banana plantation even after mulching?
Kikuyu: Hihi no wendekīthie harī mūrīmi gūītīīrīrīa maaī mūgūnda wake angīkoruo niarīīre mūcing'i?

English: Yes, it important to water the plantation even after mulching (unless there is plenty of rain).
Kikuyu: nī harī bata gūītīīrīria maaī ona ngīkorūo nī warīire mūcing'i. (no gūkorirwo mbura nyingī nīīraura)

English: Mulching does not add water to the soils but only conserves water which is already there by reducing the rate at which the soil loses water to the atmosphere.
Kikuyu: Kwarīra gūtiongagīrīra maaī tīīri-inī no nīkūgītīra marīa marī tīīri-inī matikore rīera-inī

English: What optimal ecological requirements for cabbage?
Kikuyu: Hihi nīmaūndū marīkū maria matūrigicīire magīrīire ūkūria-inī wa kabicī?

English: 700 – 2,200 metres above sea level altitude.At least 500 mm of rainfall.16 – 20 0C growing temperature.
Kikuyu: mita 700 nginya mita 2,200 igūrū wa iria. Mbura ītanyihīire 500 mm na ūrugarī wa ithimo cia 16 degree Celsius

English: Well drained sandy or silty loam soils.High organic matter content.pH range 6.0 – 6.5
Kikuyu: Tīri ūraikūrūkia maaī wega kana tīri mūirū mūhinyu. Tīri mūnoru mūingī na ūrūrū wa gītagatī kuuma 6.0 pH nginya 6.5 pH.

English: What are the growing requirements for cabbages in Kenya?
Kikuyu: Nī maūndū marīkū mabataranagia ūkūria-inī wa mboga būrūri-inī wa Kenya?

English: Cabbage is a cool season crop which requires an optimum growth temperatures range of 15- 20° C.
Kikuyu: Mboga nī mūmera wa kūndū kūrī heho na ūbataraga ūrugarī wa ithimo cia kuuma 15°C nginya 20°C

English: Head formation reduced at temperatures higher than 25 degrees Celsius.
Kikuyu: Gūkūmba kwa mboga nīkūnyihaga ūrugarī ūngīthiī makīria ma 25°C

English: It requires adequate well distributed rainfall.
Kikuyu: Ībataranagia mbura ya kūigana kīmera gīothe.

English: Moisture levels are especially critical during the early stage of the crop growth.
Kikuyu: ūigū wa tīri nīwa bata makīria kīambīrīria-inī kīa gūkūra kwa mūmera

English: If the levels are low, irrigation should be used to supplement and relive the moisture stress.
Kikuyu: Angīkorūo tīri ndūrī na wūigū wa kūigana, hebata gūitīīrīria maaī nīgūo kūehereria mūtangīko owothe ūngīrehwo nī wagi wa maaī.

English: What is the recommended fertilizer rate for cabbage growing?
Kikuyu: Hihi nī mūigana ūrīkū wa bataraitha wagīrīire kūhūthīrwo mūgūnda-inī wa mboga?

English: Apply 2 – 3 handfuls of manure per planting hole (8 tons/īka) and 2 half-litre water bottle tops (10 g) of DAP per planting hole (80 kg/īka).DAP should not be applied on acid soils, use DSP, TSP or NPK .
Kikuyu: Īkīra ngundi igirī nginya ithatū cīa thumu o irima (ūū nīkuga ūkūhūthīra tani inyanya cia thumu kūhanda īka ya mboga) ūcoke wongerere ngūnīko īmwe ya cuba ya maaī(gramu ikūmi) ya bataraitha mūthemba wa DAP irima-inī rīu (ūū nīkuga kiro mīrongo īnana cia bataraitha nīikūhūthīka kūhanda mboga īka īmwe). DAP ndīagīrīirwo kūhūthīrwo mūgūnda-inī ūrīna tīri ūrūrītio nī acid, hūthīra bataraitha mīthemba ya DSP, TSP kana NPK.

English: Only thoroughly decomposed manure should be used to avoid possible introduction of cutworms in the field.
Kikuyu: O thumu ūrīa mūhīu wega noguo ūbatiī kūhūthīka nīguo kūgirīrīria kūrehe igunyū mūgūnda-ini.

Kikuyu: Ruiru 11 nī mūthemba ūrikū wa kahūa?

English: Ruiru 11 variety was released in 1985. The variety name has the prefix “Ruiru” referring to the location of the Kenyan Coffee Research Station where the variety was developed.
Kikuyu: Ruiru 11 yarekereirio mwaka-inī wa 1985, na wetanītio na kūrīa wathundūrīirwo, Kenya Coffee Research Station.

English: The name is completed by an additional two code numbers, 11.
Kikuyu: Rītwa rīrī rīrūmīrīirwo nī namba ikūmi na īmwe.

English: The first code number denotes the type of variety as a one way cross between two designated parent populations and the second number defines the sequence of release, in this case the first release.
Kikuyu: Namba īmwe ya mbere īkoragwo īkīrūga mīrīra mūthemba wa mbegū nayo 1 ya kerī īkoragwo īkīrūgamīrīra namba harīa ya rekereirio mūtaratara-inī wa kūrekererio kwa mbeū.
